pre-commit.description: Renovate's pre-commit manager is opt-in. Without this the hook revisions in .pre-commit-config.yaml are the one dependency file nobody is watching.

packageRules.description: Automatically merge minor and patch-level updates

The Entra publishing path reads two files inside vsce that no public API covers, so a bump can break releases silently. This note reaches the reviewer of the bump, which the script headers do not: a bump touches package.json, not tools/.
prBodyNotes: :warning: Before merging, re-read two files in the new version. `out/auth.js`: if `WorkloadIdentityCredential` has joined the `ChainedTokenCredential`, `tools/marketplace-token.mjs` can be deleted in favour of `vsce publish --azure-credential`. `out/publish.js`: if `getPAT()` no longer routes `-p`/`VSCE_PAT` and `--azure-credential` into the same value, publishing is broken and there will be no other signal until a release is attempted. Also confirm `out/auth.js` still requests the scope `499b84ac-1321-427f-aa17-267ca6975798/.default`, which `tools/marketplace-token.mjs` holds a copy of. See that file and RELEASE-SETUP.md.

customManagers.description: The node:22 image that tools/publish-marketplace.sh runs vsce in is pinned by digest in a shell script, which none of the stock managers read. Without this the pin ages until a release fails on a digest upstream has garbage-collected, which RELEASE-SETUP.md already lists as a troubleshooting case.
